Job Design Experiment (15 periods)

Each period:
1. Employer offers: type (full/limited), requested effort (1-10), wage (1-50)
2. Employee decides: reject (0) or accept with effort level

Payoffs if accepted:
• Full: Employer = 5×effort - wage, Employee = wage - effort
• Limited: Employer = 4×effort - wage, Employee = wage - effort
If rejected: both earn 0

Base treatment: No information about employee history. Treat each period independently.
